name: Featured Products Carousel by Tag
author: Daniel Esparza

sections.description:
This plugin displays WooCommerce products with the tag “featured” or “destacado” in a responsive carousel using OwlCarousel2. It uses the shortcode [featured-products-carousel-tag].

Main features:
1. Shortcode [featured-products-carousel-tag] to display a product carousel.
2. Shows featured image (click → product page), title (click → product page), price (click → product page), and Add to Cart button.
3. Supports simple and variable products (uses the WooCommerce loop template).
4. Fallback to CDN for OwlCarousel2 if you don’t place the local files.
5. Translation ready (text domain: featured-products-carousel-tag).

Video

External services

This plugin includes a JavaScript file from the official OwlCarousel 2.3.4 library. That library, in its standard version, contains optional support to display videos from external services (for example Vimeo or Vzaar). In those cases, it may make requests to those services to obtain thumbnails or public metadata of the videos.

Important:
The plugin does not use or activate these video functions by default.
In the current plugin configuration, no requests to external services are made.
The connections described above would only occur if an administrator manually decides to include Vimeo or Vzaar videos in the carousels.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the featured-products-carousel-tag folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin from the WordPress admin panel.
  3. Insert the shortcode [featured-products-carousel-tag] in the page or post where you want to display it.
  4. (Optional) If you prefer to have the OwlCarousel files locally, copy owl.carousel.min.js, owl.carousel.min.css, and owl.theme.default.min.css into public/js/ and public/css/.
sections.faq:
How are products marked as featured?

Assign the tag ‘featured’ or ‘destacado’ to the products so they appear in the carousel.

Can I change the number of visible items?

Yes. Use shortcode attributes: [featured-products-carousel-tag per_page=”8″ items=”3″ autoplay=”false”].

What happens if WooCommerce is not active?

The shortcode will display a message and will not enqueue scripts.
